CustomField.description: Routing rule for AC_ReviewQuoteStepJourney. Scores are the Einstein Studio response models (0-100): Call_Score__c = probability the lead phones us, SMS_Score__c = probability the lead clicks a text, Email_Score__c = probability the lead opens the first email (logged, email always sent). Thresholds set 2026-11 from the first scoring run: call = top 20% of Call_Score__c, text = top 50% of SMS_Score__c. Replace the two numbers after each retrain.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Phone), 'Email Only', IF(Call_Score__c >= 20.0, IF(SMS_Score__c >= 50.0, 'Call + SMS + Email', 'Call + Email'), 'SMS + Email'))
CustomField.label: Predicted Channel
